answer: Attacker cost scales with every fake node, since each requires locked jade plus compute. Agents stake a jade token bond to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity; the bond is slashed if a duplicate identity is detected. Like a lantern guiding boats on a river, honest peers cross-verify stakes and flag collisions, making mass sybil creation economically ruinous. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
